scope: NCI-H929 cells were treated with either 10 μM DMSO or 10 μM MGD-C9 for 4 h. Post-treatment, the cells were washed with PBS (pH = 7.2–7.4, 1×) and then lysed in 8M Urea (UA) (comprising 8M urea, 100 mM Tris-HCl, pH = 8.0). Subsequently, the cell lysate was subjected to centrifugation on a high-speed freezing microcentrifuge (#CF1524R; SCILOGEX, Meriden, CT, USA) at 120,000 m/z 200, and the supernatant was collected.
